assessment: Synthetic trade-update routes are only registered when localTestMode and an initialized harness are present. Config validation binds local-test application and database endpoints to loopback and rejects Alpaca/OpenRouter credentials.
The input schema is strict, the request batch is bounded to 20, the whole batch is parsed before any append, retained observations are capped at 100, and reset clears them.
Submitted event hints are stored separately in memory and do not mutate canonical account positions or open orders. Persistence snapshots exclude the hints.
Response bodies use simulated/PAPER markers and fixed validation errors. Logs store only request count/status, not submitted order fields or secrets.
